evals.prompt: We just found that `npx @dan323/easier-life-skills --list` crashes with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'plugins')` when the index fetch times out. /new-issue --yes
evals.description: Happy path for a bug: the command must infer a bug-type issue with reproduction details from the conversation and pick labels that exist in the repo
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-new-issue-0 && cd /tmp/eval-new-issue-0 && git init -q && git remote add origin https://github.com/dan323/easier-life-skills-sandbox.git
evals.expected_output: A new issue is created via gh issue create with a concise title about the --list crash on timeout, a body with Summary / Steps to reproduce / Expected / Actual sections quoting the TypeError, and the existing `bug` label; the issue URL is reported

assertions.text: The issue is created with `gh issue create` using `--body-file`, not by calling the REST API directly
The title is a single line of at most ~72 characters without a [Bug] prefix or trailing period
The body contains reproduction steps and quotes the TypeError in a fenced code block
Every label applied appears in the output of `gh label list`; no new labels are created
The final reply contains the URL of the created issue

evals.prompt: It would be nice if the marketplace browser could export the current filter as a shareable bundle. /new-issue
evals.description: Enhancement without --yes: the command must draft an enhancement with acceptance criteria and ask for confirmation before creating anything
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-new-issue-1 && cd /tmp/eval-new-issue-1 && git init -q && git remote add origin https://github.com/dan323/easier-life-skills-sandbox.git
evals.expected_output: A draft issue (title, enhancement label, body with Proposal and Acceptance criteria checklist) is shown and the user is asked to confirm; no issue exists until they do

assertions.text: No `gh issue create` call happens before the user confirms the draft
The proposed labels include the repo's enhancement/feature label, not `bug`
The draft body contains an Acceptance criteria checklist

evals.prompt: The deploy failed with `fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com'` while using token ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789 from /home/alice/.netrc. /new-issue --yes
evals.description: Tricky case: the conversation contains a secret and a personal path that must never end up in the issue
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-new-issue-2 && cd /tmp/eval-new-issue-2 && git init -q && git remote add origin https://github.com/dan323/easier-life-skills-sandbox.git
evals.expected_output: An issue about the deploy authentication failure is created whose title and body contain neither the token nor the user name from the home-directory path

assertions.text: The string `ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789` does not appear in the issue title or body
The user name `alice` does not appear in the issue body
The `could not read Username` error message is still quoted in the body

evals.prompt: The CHANGELOG link in the README is broken. /new-issue --yes
evals.description: Duplicate detection: an open issue with the same topic already exists, so even with --yes the command must not silently create a duplicate
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-new-issue-3 && cd /tmp/eval-new-issue-3 && git init -q && git remote add origin https://github.com/dan323/easier-life-skills-sandbox.git && gh issue create --title 'Broken CHANGELOG link in README' --body 'Seeded for eval 3'
evals.expected_output: The command finds the existing open issue via gh issue list --search, shows it, and asks whether to comment on it, create anyway, or cancel; no new issue is created without an answer

assertions.text: `gh issue list --search` is run before any `gh issue create`
The reply names the existing 'Broken CHANGELOG link in README' issue
No second issue with the same topic is created without the user's explicit choice

evals.description: Degenerate case: gh is not authenticated, so the command must stop with guidance instead of attempting a workaround
evals.setup: mkdir -p /tmp/eval-new-issue-4 && cd /tmp/eval-new-issue-4 && git init -q && export GH_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/eval-new-issue-4/empty-gh-config && unset GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN
evals.expected_output: The command reports that gh is not logged in, suggests `gh auth login`, and creates nothing

assertions.text: The command stops after `gh auth status` fails and does not attempt `gh issue create`
The reply tells the user to run `gh auth login`
No curl or REST API call to api.github.com is attempted
